evals.name: empty-workspace-zettelkasten
evals.prompt: I'm starting a brand-new workspace for a research project on battery recycling regulations in the EU. The folder is empty: {WS}. Please set it up so my team can keep notes now and add PDFs/spreadsheets later, and so Claude can answer questions with sources. We version with git. Content language: English. (Test harness: you cannot ask me questions — choose the autonomous setup mode; when you would ask, pick the recommended default and list the question and your choice in {OUT}/questions.md.)
evals.expected_output: Zettelkasten skeleton (raw/ wiki/ kb/ docs/), kb/config.yaml with engine_version, README explaining the method, CLAUDE.md with KB rules, .claude/skills/kb/SKILL.md generated, 3 example notes + a guided first permanent note with header (type, last_reviewed, reviewed_by), kb update runs and ask finds the note, .gitignore block, kb/SETUP.md with decisions; graphify installed from the graphify-kb fork at the expected version and a graph built over code + docs/ + wiki/ (graphify-out/graph.json), version and source recorded in kb/config.yaml and kb/SETUP.md; no domain ontology forced.
assertions: Zettelkasten folders raw/ wiki/ kb/ docs/ exist
kb/config.yaml records engine_version 2.x
README explains folders, note header and precedence
CLAUDE.md has KB rules (consult /kb, precedence, never index docs/, subagents)
Workspace /kb skill generated (name: kb, uses central engine)
A guided first permanent note exists with full header
First note encodes the deadline with graph conventions
Note file names follow YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md
Example notes (fleeting/literature/permanent) clearly marked
Engine validate passes in the workspace
kb ask finds the first note (KB answers from notes)
.gitignore keeps binaries out and ignores kb/.lock and graphify-out
kb/SETUP.md records decisions
Questions the user would have been asked are listed
graphify from the fork installed at the expected version (graphify --version == graphify.version in kb/config.yaml)
graphify graph built (graphify-out/graph.json exists) even though the workspace is empty
kb/SETUP.md records graphify version, source and scope
kb/SETUP.md records Setup mode: autonomous and marks assumed decisions

evals.name: rfp-workspace-full-init
evals.prompt: This folder has the documents of an RFP we must answer: {WS} (PDFs, two spreadsheets, a DOCX and a zip, in raw/rfp/). Set up the knowledge base for the bid team. We share the folder through a Teams channel synced with OneDrive. Image descriptions are allowed for all documents; do NOT let graphify read raw/ documents, but configure it for the workspace. (Test harness: you cannot ask me questions — choose the autonomous setup mode; when you would ask, pick the recommended default and list the question and your choice in {OUT}/questions.md; treat ontology/mapping/rules checkpoints as approved after you write the proposal to {OUT}/checkpoint.md.)
evals.expected_output: OneDrive/Teams guidance summary, converted .md beside binaries, zip extracted, duplicate PDF flagged, image described via subagent, domain ontology from the rfi-proposal preset with placeholders filled, mappings for both spreadsheets (requirements + RACI) extracted, topics/facts rules that surface proposal validity 60 (RFP) vs 90 (contract terms) and environments 4 vs 3, validate ok, /kb skill + CLAUDE.md coexistence rules, graphify from the graphify-kb fork (expected version, recorded in kb/config.yaml + kb/SETUP.md) with raw/.graphifyignore excluding every raw document and a graph built over code + docs/ + wiki/, kb/SETUP.md, suggestions.
assertions: Every binary has a converted .md beside it
ZIP extracted into a sibling folder
Duplicate PDF flagged by status
No image left PENDENTE
Domain ontology created from preset (kb/ontology/<prefix>.ttl)
Engine validate passes
Mappings for both spreadsheets
All 6 requirement rows extracted as instances
RACI assignments extracted (16 cells)
Proposal validity divergence surfaced (60 vs 90 days)
Environments divergence surfaced (4 vs 3)
Workspace /kb skill generated
CLAUDE.md routes source questions to /kb and restricts graphify
graphify installed from the fork at the expected version (graphify --version == graphify.version in kb/config.yaml)
graphify graph built (graphify-out/graph.json) without raw/ documents (raw/.graphifyignore lists them; no raw/graphify-out cache)
OneDrive/Teams guidance follows Microsoft (shortcut + always keep on device + conflict copies)
kb/SETUP.md records decisions and authorizations
Checkpoint proposal written (ontology/mappings/rules)
kb/SETUP.md records Setup mode: autonomous and marks assumed decisions

evals.name: incremental-update
evals.prompt: I just added an addendum to the RFP (raw/rfp/Addendum_01.pdf) and edited our kickoff note in wiki/. Please update the knowledge base for {WS} and tell me what changed. (Test harness: no questions possible; record any question in {OUT}/questions.md.)
evals.expected_output: Only the new/changed sources processed (others unchanged), lock acquired/released, new conflict detected and resolved by precedence (addendum is newer: proposal validity 120 days wins), note re-indexed, validate ok, concise change report with citations, improvement suggestions; graphify version checked and graph updated for the changed wiki note, but not run on raw/ (not authorized).
assertions: Only the new addendum and the edited note were reprocessed
Proposal validity now resolved to 120 days (newer addendum wins)
Curator lock released
Engine validate passes
No image left PENDENTE
Change report mentions the addendum, the note and the validity change with citations
graphify not run over raw/ (no raw graphify cache)
Improvement suggestions recorded or reported
graphify graph updated after the wiki change (graphify-out/graph.json newer than before the update)

evals.name: token-eval
evals.prompt: Run the token/time/quality evaluation for {WS}: compare answering without the KB, with graphify only, and with the full KB. To keep this test short use 4 questions and 1 run; the authorized subset is raw/rfp/RFP_Customer_Platform_v1.2.pdf, raw/rfp/Attachment 3 - Security requirements.pdf and raw/rfp/General_contract_terms.docx. (Test harness: no questions possible.)
evals.expected_output: Questions + answer key by subagent (not shown in main context), graphify built over the subset only in a subagent with cost logged, per-question answering subagents for 3 configurations, runs.jsonl with tokens/duration/tool_uses from notifications, grades.json, volume JSONs, report.md via eval_report.py in kb/evals/<date>/ relating cost to volume and build cost/break-even, caveats, suggestions.
assertions: Eval report written to kb/evals/<date>/report.md
Report relates cost to data volume (volume table + tokens per 1k words)
Report covers the 3 configurations
Report includes build cost / break-even section
summary.json has measured tokens for 3 configurations
Quality measured (accuracy/citation per configuration)
No answer key or document excerpts stored in kb/evals
Build costs logged with kb.py log-cost
graphify scope limited to the authorized subset
Questions saved without answers
